channel.title: StepHaven development and design
channel.description: How an indie iPhone town builder handles drawing, time and movement.

item.title: Seasons, sunsets and full moons in StepHaven
item.description: How StepHaven follows your phone's clock and the real calendar: times of day, weather, seasons and the full-moon fair.

item.title: A cozy town with no image files
item.description: How StepHaven draws a whole town in Core Graphics code, generates its world from a seed, and syncs shared towns over CloudKit with no server.

item.title: Every kind of moving counts: wheelchair pushes and Ember workouts
item.description: Wheelchair pushes count like steps in StepHaven, and Ember turns workouts into points for your town.
